background: Credit Agricole CIB is the corporate and investment bank of the Credit Agricole group, funded in wholesale markets and by corporate deposits, active in structured finance, capital markets and international trade and transaction banking.
synthesis: All three main agencies rate the bank, AA- on average with the weakest at A+, one on a negative outlook and two on a stable outlook; one of the three moved to negative outlook on 3 Nov 2026, after a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 12 May 2026. The rating rests on group support rather than the bank's own ratios, which are all in the bottom quarter of EU and Nordic banks: CET1 of 12.4%, leverage of 3.6%, LCR of 120% and NSFR of 112%. None of the ratios has moved materially over the past four periods to 30 Jun 2026.
